page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c9i.6xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual server running on the KVM hypervisor. The instance is powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor clocked at 3.2 GHz, supplying 24 dedicated virtual CPUs. Memory allocation is set at 48.0 GB of system RAM, maintaining a strict 1:2 compute-optimized memory-to-vCPU ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU.

The server configuration does not include bundled local storage, requiring network-attached storage volumes for file systems and persistent state. It features a baseline network bandwidth of 15 Gbps and includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. There are no discrete hardware accelerators or GPUs configured on this model.

By pairing dedicated Intel Xeon cores with a compact memory footprint and externalized storage, ecs.c9i.6xlarge targets CPU-heavy execution paths without allocating unneeded RAM overhead. This resource balance provides cost efficiency for batch computing, CI/CD compilation runners, front-end web serving fleets, distributed analytics nodes, and CPU-bound microservices that rely on network storage.
